Here's a concise implementation plan for `triples_sum_to_zero`:

• Use three nested loops to iterate through all possible combinations of three distinct elements (using different indices i, j, k where i < j < k to avoid duplicates and ensure distinctness)

• For each triple of elements at positions i, j, and k, check if their sum equals zero; if found, immediately return True

• If no triple summing to zero is found after checking all combinations, return False
